option.name: --backend
tip: Backend used for creating venvs and managing packages.
Defaults to PIPX_DEFAULT_BACKEND when set, else 'uv' when uv is available (via the `pipx[uv]` extra or on PATH), else 'pip'.
Commands on an existing venv keep its recorded backend and warn when this flag differs; `pipx reinstall` and `pipx reinstall-all` rebuild venvs with it.
Possible values: pip, uv

option.name: --cooldown
tip: Ignore index artifacts uploaded fewer than DAYS days ago.
Defaults to PIPX_COOLDOWN; pass 0 to opt out.

option.name: --editable
tip: Install a project in editable mode

option.name: --force
tip: Modify existing virtual environment and files in PIPX_BIN_DIR and PIPX_MAN_DIR

option.name: --include-apps
tip: Add apps from the injected packages onto your PATH and expose their manual pages

option.name: --include-deps
tip: Include apps and manual pages from all dependencies

option.name: --include-resources-from
tip: Include apps and manual pages from this dependency.
Repeat for multiple dependencies

option.name: --index-url
tip: Base URL of Python Package Index

option.name: --pip-args
tip: Arbitrary pip arguments to pass directly to pip install/upgrade commands.

Under the uv backend, `pipx run` translates a subset (--index-url/-i, --extra-index-url, --find-links/-f, --trusted-host, --no-binary, --only-binary, --pre, --upgrade/-U, --no-cache-dir) and rejects other flags.
Other commands pass them to `uv pip install` unchanged.

option.name: --requirement
tip: File containing the packages to inject into the Virtual Environment--one package name or pip package spec per line.
May be specified multiple times.

option.name: --system-site-packages
tip: Give the virtual environment access to the system site-packages dir. Ignored, since the existing environment keeps the venv options it was installed with; accepted for compatibility.

option.name: --with-suffix
tip: Add the suffix (if given) of the Virtual Environment to the packages to inject

option.name: --fetch-python
tip: When to fetch a standalone Python build from python-build-standalone.
'always' always downloads (ignores any system Python); 'missing' downloads only when the requested version is not found locally; 'never' never downloads.

option.name: --lock

Under the uv backend, `pipx run` translates a subset (--index-url/-i, --extra-index-url, --find-links/-f, --trusted-host, --no-binary, --only-binary, --pre, --upgrade/-U, --no-cache-dir) and rejects other flags.
Other commands pass them to `uv pip install` unchanged.

option.name: --preinstall
tip: Optional package to be installed into the Virtual Environment before installing the main package.
Use this flag multiple times if you want to preinstall multiple packages.

option.name: --python
tip: Python to install with.
Possible values can be the executable name (python3.11), the version of an available system Python or to pass to py launcher (3.11), or the full path to the executable.
Requires Python 3.11 or above.

option.name: --suffix
tip: Optional suffix for virtual environment and executable names.
It goes at the end of each app name (pip3.14 becomes pip3.14_a), before the file extension on Windows (pip3.14_a.exe, hello_a.py).

option.name: --system-site-packages
tip: Give the virtual environment access to the system site-packages dir.

option.name: --upgrade
tip: Upgrade or downgrade an existing package when its version does not satisfy the supplied spec, removing exposed apps, manual pages, and shell completions the new version no longer ships

option.name: --upgrade-strategy
tip: How dependency upgrades are handled when --upgrade changes an existing package
Possible values: only-if-needed, eager
